name: ai-security-monitor
description: Enterprise-grade real-time AI security intelligence, zero-day threat monitoring, and autonomous LLM triage system.
tech_stack: Ollama (Local LLM GPU Triage via llama3.1:8b)
conventions: Clean architecture: domain, application, infrastructure, presentation layers
Async SQLAlchemy Unit of Work pattern for persistence
Strict type hinting and dataclasses across domain models
Luxury dark aesthetic with obsidian palette and refined glassmorphism
Strict user rule: Focus on broad global AI news (trending GitHub repos, developer tools, frontier models, research breakthroughs) and omit security unless explicitly asked
Strict user rule: News must mostly be within 2 weeks old (maximum 14 days) — discard stale historical items

Strict user rule: 100% Free & Zero-Cost Architecture ($0/month Law) — never introduce paid APIs, subscriptions, commercial SaaS, or paywalled services; rely exclusively on local SLMs (Apache 2.0), generous free-tiers, direct public RPCs, and permissive open source
architecture_patterns: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with clear boundary contexts
Repository pattern with dynamic SQL query ordering and filtering
Reactive WebSocket telemetry broadcast for live sweeps and emergency zero-days
Asynchronous background worker queue for GPU LLM threat triage

file_structure.src/ai_security_monitor/domain: Core entities, value objects, domain events, repository interfaces
file_structure.src/ai_security_monitor/application: Service orchestration, autonomous triage engine, monitor service
file_structure.src/ai_security_monitor/infrastructure: SQLAlchemy repositories, fetchers, epistemic analyzers, delivery
file_structure.src/ai_security_monitor/presentation: FastAPI REST router, WebSockets, CLI interface
file_structure.web/index.html: Single-page responsive HUD dashboard with Three.js globe and luxury styling
file_structure.tests: Integration and unit test suites mirroring architecture

patterns: Unit tests for heuristic and blast radius analyzers
Unit tests for delivery channels (email, telegram, slack, console)
Integration tests for REST endpoints and live database sorting
Autonomous triage queue worker and deduplication tests
Strict Mypy type verification with 0 errors across entire codebase

sprint_focus: Building the user onboarding flow with email verification and profile setup.
never_do: Never focus on cybersecurity, CVEs, or vulnerability telemetry unless the user explicitly requests it
Never ingest or surface news older than 2 weeks (14 days max) — keep all intelligence strictly fresh
Never autonomously merge pull requests or run gh pr merge — always leave PRs open for human user review
Never introduce or require paid APIs, recurring subscriptions, commercial licenses, or cloud billing (everything must be 100% free and open-source)
Never use useEffect for data fetching — use Server Components or SWR
Never store secrets in .env files committed to git
Never use inline styles — always use Tailwind classes
Never use `any` TypeScript type — always type explicitly
Never mix database queries into React components
preferred_patterns: Use Zod for all schema validation
Use Drizzle ORM for all database access
Use Next.js Image component for all images
learned_lessons: AutoThrottle floor_delay must check explicit `<= 0.0` to bypass delays for tests and zero-limit sources.
Domain Entry entities require source_id (UUID) and use summary/metadata for text storage rather than a content keyword.
Hacker News Algolia API hits should be enriched with top discussion comments from the item endpoint to capture developer sentiment.
Balanced digest quota selection prevents single-source flood (e.g. RSS bursts) from drowning out frontier models and papers.
Anti-AI-slop cleaning requires multi-pass stripping to handle nested conversational preambles (e.g. 'Sure, here is the technical summary:').
SSRF defense for proxy endpoints requires both IP literal bounds checking and DNS resolution verification to block private and link-local ranges.
URL tracking parameter stripping on incoming feeds ensures canonical deduplication across disparate social/syndication channels.
Fetcher parsing: variables like content_hash and metadata must never be defined inside iterative item loops to avoid UnboundLocalError when collections are empty.
SlowAPI rate limiter should be disabled under pytest execution to prevent rate limit accumulation and cross-test 429 interference.
MinHash 64-permutation Jaccard estimation must guard against all-zero signatures to prevent empty token sets from erroneously matching as 1.0 duplicates.
sqlite-vec C extension loading in SQLAlchemy async engines requires enabling load_extension on the underlying dbapi_connection within the sync_engine 'connect' event listener.
Rocchio personalization centroids require dual-query retrieval of positive (vaulted) and negative (purged/dismissed) entries, and mock UOWs in tests must accommodate both list calls.
Telegram inline keyboard callback_data payloads must strictly stay below 64 UTF-8 bytes; long source slugs should be hashed to 16-hex prefixes, and entry UUIDs should use 32-hex characters.
Telegram long-polling (getUpdates) throws HTTP 409 Conflict if a webhook was previously active; calling deleteWebhook(drop_pending_updates=False) during startup eliminates this conflict.
Telegram delivery instances in service constructors should be lazy-loaded to prevent DeliveryConfigError when testing or running unconfigured environments.

Local SLM Fast-Fail Circuit Breaker: Use short (<=500ms) connection timeout and an active cooldown (300s) on connection failures so when the daemon is offline, requests immediately fail fast to cloud frontier or heuristic synthesis without network latency.

Small Model (SLM) Structured Output Resilience: Small 3B-7B models often wrap JSON in markdown code blocks or leave trailing commas before brackets; combining multi-pass regex fence stripping, comma repair, and balanced bracket extraction prevents json.loads failures.

Prompt Caching Prefix Isolation: Static system prompts must strictly sit at index 0 isolated from dynamic runtime variables to trigger automatic prefix caching in OpenAI/Gemini/Groq and ephemeral block caching in Anthropic.

Personal Intelligence Decision Brief: Action determination must check non-technical marketing hype (no-match on stack, no repository or paper artifact) for IGNORE_HYPE before falling into generic preliminary MONITOR_CLAIMS, while strictly preserving UPGRADE_DEPENDENCY security safeguards (requiring both direct impact and identified affected components).

Browser TLS Impersonation Fallback: When scrapers encounter HTTP 403/429/Cloudflare challenges, fall back to curl_cffi with Chrome 131 TLS/JA3 impersonation if installed, and seamlessly degrade to rotating desktop User-Agent and Sec-Ch-Ua client hints if curl_cffi is missing or challenged.

Source Auto-Quarantine Circuit Breaker: When a source fails >= 5 consecutive sweeps, trip circuit breaker to QUARANTINED, suspend sweeps for 12 hours with half-open exponential probe, and dispatch a single Telegram alert with inline [🔄 Retry & Unquarantine Source] (uq:<slug>) callback button for instant recovery.

Zero-Trust Offline PWA App Shell: Standalone PWA support over Tailscale/localhost requires web/manifest.json and web/sw.js with explicit FastAPI routes serving Service-Worker-Allowed: / and caching App Shell with network-first offline API fallback.

Structured AI Entity & Benchmark Knowledge Graph: Relational entry_entities table links model families, GitHub repos, arXiv IDs, and benchmarks with bidirectional metric extraction (e.g. 'scored 79.8% on AIME 2024' vs 'SWE-bench: 49.2%') and longest-first span suppression (preventing sub-string duplicate false positives like MMLU within MMLU-Pro), querying exact entity timelines across the 14-day freshness window.

Chinese GitHub Trending & Bilingual Intelligence Corridor: GitHub Trending scraping requires configurable spoken_language_code ('zh' for Chinese) and bilingual keyword matching in _AI_KEYWORDS (e.g. '大模型', '智能体', '推理', '知识库') to prevent Chinese open-source repos from being dropped. Additionally, is_english_source must exempt Chinese sources to ensure title and summary translations are automatically executed while preserving invariant model and repo placeholders.

China AI Open-Source Repository Intelligence & Epistemic Profiling: Chinese developer repositories require dedicated epistemic parsing (ChinaRepoIntelligenceExtractor) extracting architectural archetypes (foundation_model, inference_runtime, agentic_system, rag_knowledge_base, multimodal_voice, eval_and_benchmark, dev_tool), lab authority mapping (DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Shanghai AI Lab, Zhipu, InfiniFlow), parameter scales, context lengths, VRAM/hardware targets, quantization, serving frameworks, and open-source licenses, enriched on-the-fly during API serialization and filterable via archetype and lab query parameters.

100% Free & Zero-Cost Architecture ($0/Month Law): The entire project must run with zero operational cost and zero subscription dependencies. Use Apache 2.0 licensed local SLMs (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b/3b via Ollama/llama.cpp), free-tier cloud APIs (Groq), direct public endpoints (Google GTX RPC), and embedded MIT/Apache offline libraries (Argos Translate with AI token shielding). Never introduce paid API keys, paid token quotas, or commercial cloud bills.

Render 512MB RAM OOM Protection & Local-First Governance: Containers with strict memory limits (Render 512MB Free Tier) crash when SQLite uses default MMAP (256MB) and cache (-16000), or when FastEmbed/ONNX runtime loads into memory. Mitigate by: (1) detecting cgroup v1/v2 memory limits and process RSS in AutoscaledPool; (2) clamping SQLite to 4MB cache, 32MB mmap, FILE temp_store, and wal_autocheckpoint=100; (3) defaulting to zero-daemon 384-d pseudo-vector embeddings on low-memory/container hosts; (4) bounding response cache and translation cache; (5) clearing ReportLab NumberedCanvas state dicts and invoking gc.collect() post-sweep; and (6) offering 100% on-demand local execution (./scripts/run_local.sh) adhering to Arch Linux process governance.

Autonomous Multi-Source Research Loop: Hybrid retrieval blends sqlite-vec KNN, entity graph intersection, and half-life decay velocity; date filtering must normalize Python offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes with a fallback timezone converter to strictly uphold the <= 14-day freshness invariant across SQLite models.

Async SQLAlchemy sqlite-vec Loading: When using SQLAlchemy async engine with aiosqlite, dbapi_connection in the 'connect' event listener is wrapped as AsyncAdapt_aiosqlite_connection. Invoking enable_load_extension directly raises AttributeError. Unwrapping via while hasattr(raw_conn, '_connection'): raw_conn = raw_conn._connection reaches the raw sqlite3.Connection, allowing sqlite_vec.load() and vec0 virtual tables to initialize without error.

Cross-Language Semantic Cluster Graph: To avoid test-isolation import breakage and guarantee deterministic clustering, golden evaluation benchmarks (such as the 20-pair hand-labeled precision test set) must reside within application service modules rather than tests/, enabling production services and gates to verify precision >= 0.90 without circular or out-of-package dependencies.

Encrypted Offsite Backup & Restore Drill: Native SQLite online snapshotting via VACUUM INTO produces clean point-in-time files without blocking WAL readers. Asymmetric age (pyrage X25519) encryption allows edge/server nodes to encrypt with only a public key (age1...), while restore drills execute offline with the private key (AGE-SECRET-KEY-1...) to verify PRAGMA integrity_check and table row-count parity.

Multilingual Event-Intelligence Architecture: Never route foreign intelligence through 'translate-first' pipelines; store documents in native language with script detection (Hans vs Hant), resolve language-independent canonical entities/aliases, and reserve machine translation strictly for human presentation views.

Language-Parity SLO Governance: Language parity requires monitoring both capture yield and publication-to-fetch latency parity (median & p90) against a <= 1.25x reference ratio; single-repo GitHub Atom feeds for frontier AI labs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Moonshot) stagnate quickly and must be replaced by org-level API polling (Hugging Face / ModelScope orgs).

Multilingual Regex Word Boundaries: In Python regex, \w matches all CJK ideographs under Unicode; using \b fails when an ASCII identifier is immediately adjacent to Chinese text (e.g. 发布DeepSeek-R1模型). Using ASCII boundary lookarounds (?<![A-Za-z0-9_]) and (?![A-Za-z0-9_]) reliably extracts entity spans without whitespace dependency.

Conditional HTTP ETag Feed Recovery: When a database is reset or a source yields 0 entries despite active publication, cached ETags in sources.config cause perpetual HTTP 304 Not Modified skips; clearing the cached ETag unlocks fresh retrieval of active items.

Cross-Lingual Event Resolution & Entity Unification: Documents across disparate languages (e.g. Chinese announcement and English tech media) cluster into a single canonical event by matching shared canonical entity IDs and version tags within a 72-hour sliding time window, establishing evidentiary hierarchy (primary lab vs corroborating media).

Deterministic Multilingual Factual Claims: Extracting parameter counts (671B vs 6710亿参数), context lengths (128K vs 128k长文本), and benchmark percentages (SWE-bench: 49.2%) directly into normalized values with exact character-offset evidence spans guarantees verifiable facts without translation distortion.

Async SQLAlchemy Relationship Identity Map Isolation: In async sessions, relationship collections (event.documents, doc.mentions) should be explicitly queried rather than accessed lazily or relying on cached ORM attributes, preventing MissingGreenlet exceptions and stale collection size assertions.

Lazy-Cached Machine Translation vs Mutable Ingestion: Machine translation must never sit on the ingestion hot-path; serving translations on-demand as versioned views in document_views (view_type='mt_en', producer='google_mt:v1') provides instant retrieval after initial view generation while preserving original native text immutability and preventing external API rate-limiting during background sweeps.

Cross-Lingual Event Brief Synthesis: Event executive summaries must synthesize across all primary and corroborating sources and grounded claims rather than single articles, presenting a unified timeline that highlights cross-lingual lead/lag deltas without generating unverified AI hallucination filler.

Event-Level Parity Governance vs Document Count: Tracking parity at the document level is easily distorted by syndication volume; evaluating parity at the canonical event level directly reveals breakthrough discovery lead/lag deltas (hours) and enforces native capture targets (>=80%) for frontier AI labs.

CLI SLO Guard Exit Codes: Providing automated --check-slo flags on telemetry scripts allows continuous monitoring and CI/CD quality gates to fail fast when native multilingual capture drops to zero, and passing an optional unit-of-work instance enables complete database fixture isolation in unit tests.
